## Moves

### Itsy Bitsy Teenie Weenie

Whether you’re a perfect fairy princess or just the runt of the litter, you’re small in stature. When being diminutive would help with an action, take advantage on associated rolls. When stacked with something from your Beach Bag, take double advantage (roll four and take the two highest).

### Wipeout

You’re at your best when the chips are down. Add 1 to Composure. When you mark The Red Star, increase your die result by two tiers instead of one.

### Hey Little Cobra

You’re always coiled and ready to strike—mentally and physically. Add 1 to both Vitality and Reason.

### Pipeline

You’ve always had a connection to the Other Side. Add 1 to Sensitivity. When entering a new Location, you can ask, “What is about to happen?” The Keeper will answer truthfully, but not necessarily completely.

### Third Gear, Hang On Tight

You have a knack for getting somewhere—or out of somewhere—fast. Once per game, when you and any number of other characters are in danger, you can describe how you narrowly escape instead. Additionally, once per game, you can be somewhere immediately, ready for action; take your next die roll at advantage.

### Tear it Up

You may not be the best dancer at St. Bernadette’s, but you’re pretty close. The Dance Party Move can be performed twice. Additionally, you find a Clue during the dance party. Say what it is; the Clue cannot conclusively answer the Question by itself.
